messages:
marta: Heads-up — planning a short rolling maintenance for APAC edge (apac-west1) this Sat 02:00-04:00 UTC. NIC firmware + staggered GPU soft reboots. Targeting minimal impact but want to deconflict scheduled large-batch jobs and any planned demos.

devon: Thanks. Which racks/pools exactly? we should mark capacity for warm-backfill.

marta: We'll hit pool-apac-edge-1 and pool-apac-edge-2, 2 racks each, sequential cordon -> drain -> reboot. Expect ~20% capacity reduction per pool for ~15-20m while rack drains. overall traffic should route to other regions automatically but some latency increase for APAC clients.

kai: Can we route latency-sensitive tenants to dedicated apac-dedicated-1 during the window? I can arrange temp reserve if needed but need heads-up by EOD Fri.

leah: Noted from customer success — two customers have scheduled inference experiments Sat 03:00 UTC. I'll ping them and see if they can move to earlier times. If they can't, we need guaranteed fallback.

ops-bot: Alert created: MAINT-APAC-2025-0426. Automated routing policy will enable cross-region fallback after 02:05 UTC if regional P95 latency > 700ms for 5min.

simon: For the drain sequence, recommend using graceful drain + prefix cache warmup after each rack. Example:

```
kubectl cordon node/<node>
kubectl drain node/<node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=15m
# warm cache: /scripts/prefix-warmup --pool pool-apac-edge-1 --concurrency 4
```

Also set autoscaler to keep one extra preemptible slot in us-east as short-term hedge.

marta: Good call. We'll inject a 10m gap between racks to let prefix warmup complete. Ops, please ensure the cache warmup script points to the right model_version tag.

kai: Cost note — cross-region fallback will increase egress and token cost ~+12-18% for the window. If customers need guaranteed SLAs we should offer a temporary paid reserve option.

nora: Oncall FYI: I'll be at the NOC during window and will monitor throttles. Will post a short status update after each rack completes. If we see sustained error spikes we'll fail traffic to apac-dedicated-1 and pause further reboots.

leah: I've told the two customers. One moved to 23:00 UTC Fri, other asked for guaranteed fallback. I'll coordinate with Kai for a paid reserve.

devon: Also check NIC firmware batch id: FW-APAC-2025-3. Last run had 0.6% transient NIC flaps, fixed by backoff in driver. We'll enable xmit backoff workaround on nodes being updated.

marta: Thanks. Timeline: Start 02:00 UTC; rack A1 02:00-02:25, gap 02:25-02:35, rack A2 02:35-03:00, pool swap to pool-apac-edge-2 03:00-03:05, racks B1/B2 03:05-03:50. Post-checks 03:50-04:00. Will post runbook in the runbooks channel.

simon: +1 to runbook. Add roll-back step: if drain step fails >15m, re-enable scheduling and abort further reboots.

marta: OK. @ops-bot please pin the runbook and create an incident channel for the window. Everyone: reply if you have blocking scheduled work.

nora: I'll be live on the incident channel. :white_check_mark:

leah: I'll confirm customer fallback plan by 18:00 UTC.

marta: Great — thanks team. We'll proceed unless any final objections. :rocket:
